article.title: The climate is also on your grocery bill
article.author: Editor
article.content: Spain is heading to the polls and nobody wants to talk about the ecological crisis. But it is already in the price of olive oil, the floods in Valencia and the heatwaves that kill thousands every summ. The post The climate is also on your grocery bill appeared first on MR Online .
